name: open-code-review
description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
one_liner: An automatic reviewer that reads every code change before it ships and leaves exact, line-by-line comments catching bugs and security holes — like having a senior engineer review every pull request, instantly.
buyer: An engineering manager at a mid-size company who needs consistent code review but can't get senior engineers to review every pull request.
business_use_cases: An engineering team wires it into CI so every pull request gets an automated security and bug pass before a human ever looks at it.
A dev agency offers 'enterprise-grade code review' as a value-add to clients without hiring more senior reviewers.
A fintech startup uses its SQL-injection and thread-safety rules to catch compliance-relevant bugs automatically before audits.

money_ideas.idea: Host it as a managed SaaS for teams that don't want to self-host, billed per repo or per seat

steal_this: Stand up a hosted version, connect it to GitHub via an OAuth app, and charge small dev teams a flat monthly fee per repo instead of making them self-host the infrastructure.
